reference_method: Full transcription of the bounded income-statement crop, manually checked against the rendered CafeF scan. The transcription is adapted from a visually reviewed duplicate capture and then verified against this page; it is not independent double-entry annotation.
limitations: One Vietnamese page from a separate archive scan capture of the same 2011 statement, not a new issuer/report/year. Labels were visually checked against the crop but adapted from the existing duplicate-statement transcription, not independently double-entered. The PDF is hosted by CafeF, not Vinamilk. This diagnostic measures capture-to-capture OCR robustness only and cannot establish representative Vietnamese OCR quality or select a production engine.

environment.cpu_peak_scope: whole evaluator process; run one engine per invocation for engine-specific comparison
environment.child_peak_scope: maximum high-water RSS among completed child processes, where supported
